lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
forms-main: 13 B beyond the first copy, vue-demi 13 B.
forms-submit: 13 B beyond the first copy, vue-demi 13 B.
forms-settings: 13 B beyond the first copy, vue-demi 13 B.
All 4 pages load the same 2 files: 644,548 B raw, 140,667 B gzip, 94.9 % of the smallest page (forms-emptyContent, 679,242 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/vue 488,781 B, vue 75,017 B, vue-router 29,527 B, dompurify 21,806 B, semver 8,257 B.
css holds 4 stylesheets, 258,464 B, and no page of this build loads any of them: no entry in js is named after one, and none is reached from an entry that is.

Loaded from PHP: embedded.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), forms-style.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), forms.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), public.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php).
Each is loaded from PHP or built into the bundle, so none is left without a loader. Where the build writes its stylesheets somewhere else, --css=DIR names that directory.
moment, 292,957 B on the forms-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,272 B on the forms-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (77 packages, 464 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
